proof_body:
by
  intro Ω _ P _ X Y c d hX hY hV
  have mse : ∀ (Z : Ω → ℝ) (e : ℝ), MeasureTheory.MemLp Z 2 P → ∫ ω, (Z ω - e) ^ 2 ∂P = ProbabilityTheory.variance Z P + ((∫ ω, Z ω ∂P) - e) ^ 2 := by
    intro Z e hZ
    have hi1 : MeasureTheory.Integrable (fun ω => Z ω ^ 2) P := hZ.integrable_sq
    have hi2 : MeasureTheory.Integrable Z P := hZ.integrable one_le_two
    have e1 : ∫ ω, Z ω ^ 2 - 2 * e * Z ω + e ^ 2 ∂P = ∫ ω, Z ω ^ 2 - 2 * e * Z ω ∂P + ∫ _ω, e ^ 2 ∂P := MeasureTheory.integral_add (hi1.sub (hi2.const_mul _)) (MeasureTheory.integrable_const _)
    have e2 : ∫ ω, Z ω ^ 2 - 2 * e * Z ω ∂P = ∫ ω, Z ω ^ 2 ∂P - ∫ ω, 2 * e * Z ω ∂P := MeasureTheory.integral_sub hi1 (hi2.const_mul _)
    have e3 : (fun ω => (Z ω - e) ^ 2) = fun ω => Z ω ^ 2 - 2 * e * Z ω + e ^ 2 := by funext ω; ring
    rw [e3, e1, e2, MeasureTheory.integral_const_mul, ProbabilityTheory.variance_eq_sub hZ]
    simp only [Pi.pow_apply, MeasureTheory.integral_const, MeasureTheory.probReal_univ, one_smul]
    ring
  have vard : ∀ b : ℝ, ProbabilityTheory.variance (fun ω => Y ω - b * X ω) P = ProbabilityTheory.variance Y P - 2 * b * ProbabilityTheory.covariance X Y P + b ^ 2 * ProbabilityTheory.variance X P := by
    intro b
    rw [ProbabilityTheory.variance_fun_sub hY (hX.const_mul b), ProbabilityTheory.variance_const_mul, ProbabilityTheory.covariance_const_mul_right, ProbabilityTheory.covariance_comm]
    ring
  set b := ProbabilityTheory.covariance X Y P / ProbabilityTheory.variance X P with hb
  have hL : ∀ e : ℝ, MeasureTheory.MemLp (fun ω => Y ω - e * X ω) 2 P := fun e => hY.sub (hX.const_mul e)
  have h1 : ∫ ω, (Y ω - ((∫ ω', Y ω' ∂P) - b * ∫ ω', X ω' ∂P) - b * X ω) ^ 2 ∂P = ProbabilityTheory.variance (fun ω => Y ω - b * X ω) P := by
    have := mse (fun ω => Y ω - b * X ω) ((∫ ω', Y ω' ∂P) - b * ∫ ω', X ω' ∂P) (hL b)
    have hm : ∫ ω, Y ω - b * X ω ∂P = (∫ ω', Y ω' ∂P) - b * ∫ ω', X ω' ∂P := by
      rw [MeasureTheory.integral_sub (hY.integrable one_le_two) ((hX.integrable one_le_two).const_mul b), MeasureTheory.integral_const_mul]
    rw [hm, sub_self] at this
    simp only [ne_eq, OfNat.ofNat_ne_zero, not_false_eq_true, zero_pow, add_zero] at this
    rw [← this]
    refine MeasureTheory.integral_congr_ae (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun ω => ?_)
    simp only
    ring
  have h2 : ∫ ω, (Y ω - c - d * X ω) ^ 2 ∂P = ProbabilityTheory.variance (fun ω => Y ω - d * X ω) P + ((∫ ω, Y ω - d * X ω ∂P) - c) ^ 2 := by
    rw [← mse _ c (hL d)]
    refine MeasureTheory.integral_congr_ae (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun ω => ?_)
    simp only
    ring
  rw [h1, h2, vard, vard]
  have hsq : 0 ≤ ((∫ ω, Y ω - d * X ω ∂P) - c) ^ 2 := sq_nonneg _
  have hb2 : b * ProbabilityTheory.variance X P = ProbabilityTheory.covariance X Y P := by
    rw [hb]; field_simp
  have hpos : 0 ≤ (d - b) ^ 2 * ProbabilityTheory.variance X P := by positivity
  have hk : (ProbabilityTheory.variance Y P - 2 * d * ProbabilityTheory.covariance X Y P + d ^ 2 * ProbabilityTheory.variance X P) - (ProbabilityTheory.variance Y P - 2 * b * ProbabilityTheory.covariance X Y P + b ^ 2 * ProbabilityTheory.variance X P) = (d - b) ^ 2 * ProbabilityTheory.variance X P := by
    rw [← hb2]; ring
  linarith
target_source: ∀ (Ω : Type*) [MeasurableSpace Ω] (P : MeasureTheory.Measure Ω) [MeasureTheory.IsProbabilityMeasure P] (X Y : Ω → ℝ) (c d : ℝ), MeasureTheory.MemLp X 2 P → MeasureTheory.MemLp Y 2 P → 0 < ProbabilityTheory.variance X P → ∫ ω, (Y ω - ((∫ ω', Y ω' ∂P) - ProbabilityTheory.covariance X Y P / ProbabilityTheory.variance X P * ∫ ω', X ω' ∂P) - ProbabilityTheory.covariance X Y P / ProbabilityTheory.variance X P * X ω) ^ 2 ∂P ≤ ∫ ω, (Y ω - c - d * X ω) ^ 2 ∂P
